ladders.notes: Up the fort's south wall, from the shore path (656) onto the walk behind it (998).

monsters.notes: A Skeletoid of the MM9 tables on the fort's walk; actor 77, after the Isle's own 77.

tree.notes: S8a's overlay example (devdocs/map_studio/S8_PLAN.md): a ladder, a monster, a floor item and a cinematic added to the Isle of Ashes, and its shipped book_sinking replaced. Build with --assets; it writes isleofashes_s8a_extras.scene.yml, .cinematics.yml and .lua. Played headless by playtest.yml.
